answer: To grade, an agent must buy a 24-day clone-liability policy underwritten by three unaffiliated insurers after a live inspection, locking 2,200 units with each office. An insurer may bind at most two new policies a week; a reused face, device, or funding trail cancels cover and burns the premium. An honest worker spends 6,600 units once. Raising 120 aliases needs 360 inspections and 264,000 units of cover. No single haven can issue the whole book, and a reef of shell offices that share staff is refused, so the fable that personas are free does not survive underwriting.
